name: Aura Salla - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the proposal for a decision of the European Parliament and of the Council on the mobilisation of the European Globalisation Adjustment Fund for Displaced Workers following an application from Sweden – EGF/2025/003 SE/Northvolt
part_text:
1. The European Parliament agrees to release 8.5 million euros from a European Union fund that helps workers who lose their jobs. The money goes to Sweden to help 5,800 people laid off when the battery maker Northvolt went bankrupt in March 2025. The fund pays for job coaching, training, and support to start a business. The Parliament also asks for faster handling of such requests and for clear checks on how the money is spent.

2. • The European Union pays Sweden 8.5 million euros, 60 percent of the 14.2 million euro support plan.
• It affects 5,800 former Northvolt workers, mostly in Skellefteå, who get training and job help.
• Sweden runs the measures; Parliament wants final checks on results and money use.
